S05.meta: // SLIDE 05 — WHERE IT BROKE: two MIS exceptions — low rectal (warning) vs cervical LACC (verdict)

data.question: Does minimally invasive surgery produce equivalent oncologic outcomes?

branches.label: Low rectal cancer — warning sign
branches.detail: ACOSOG Z6051 and ALaCaRT: slightly inferior pathologic specimen quality and margin rates with laparoscopic TME. Longer-term survival differences smaller. Interpretation ongoing.
branches.fix: Rectal surgery requires separate evaluation from colonic surgery — a signal, not a verdict.

branches.label: Cervical cancer (LACC 2018) — verdict
branches.detail: Minimally invasive radical hysterectomy: recurrence rate several-fold higher, lower overall survival. Trial stopped early for harm.
branches.fix: Open surgery is now the recommended approach. The harm is a measured fact.

resolver.label: The mechanism is a working hypothesis — the harm is not
resolver.detail: Three candidates: uterine manipulator, CO₂ insufflation, technique differences. None is established as the cause. But the outcome is unambiguous.

S07.meta: // SLIDE 07 — THE EPISTEMIC FAILURE: equivalence assumed across operations, trial ran late, harm measured late

data.startLabel: MIS adoption — oncologic equivalence assumed from prior results

stages.label: Cervical — equivalence assumed, thousands of operations performed
LACC trial finally runs — harm discovered

data.endClaim: The proxy (faster recovery) displaced the outcome (cancer recurrence). The oncologic question was not asked because the answer was assumed.

S09.meta: // SLIDE 09 — RECONSTRUCTION: two different logics — changes patient tolerance vs changes cancer outcome

data.startLabel: Reconstructive surgery added to cancer resection

tracks.label: Function and quality of life
tracks.outcome: Makes necessary resections tolerable — expands what surgery the patient can accept
notes: Free-flap in head and neck: allows resections otherwise incompatible with speech and swallowing
Limb-salvage for sarcoma: validated equivalent to amputation by 1980s randomized trials
Breast reconstruction: restores body image, affects willingness to undergo necessary surgery

tracks.label: Oncologic outcome
tracks.outcome: Reconstruction does not change whether the cancer is removed or whether it recurs
notes: Survival and recurrence determined by the resection and adjuvant therapy — not reconstruction
Reconstruction's contribution is to the patient's life after treatment
Evidence base is about function and quality of life, not survival
